_meta.note: Self-host price additions for SKUs the upstream curated catalog lacks — this instance's unpriced queue tail. Same schema as curated-overrides.json (exact/alias/fuzzy/source_exact), merged in-memory by api/_lib/pricing/index.js at require time; each addition is cloned with a _selfhost flag, which getModelPricingInfo surfaces as source "selfhost-curated" so a rate's origin is always answerable. Upstream curated-overrides.json stays the price source of record and is never mutated or overridden: on a key collision the upstream entry wins and the selfhost entry is dropped. Every priced entry carries a note with the official source URL and verification date. SKUs without an official published price are intentionally absent (the findings are recorded right here in this note — the docs/selfhost-vercel-supabase.md section referenced here before 2026-11-03 no longer exists): opencode/union-alpha (limited-time stealth-free window ended ~2026-10-10 and the model is no longer on the Zen catalog; its successor OpenRouter route is paid), dsh/space-bunny (revealed as MiniMax M3.1 Flash third-hand, with no MiniMax per-token list price; the dsh route is undisclosed), dsh/qfmodel (routed through Qoder CN allowance accounts per a community multiplexer observation — allowance-backed, not per-token billable), qoder/custom_model (undisclosed user route). Inventing prices is worse than unpriced. 2026-11-03: step-5-preview was promoted into curated-overrides.json (upstream catalog is the price source of record; same official rates, cache_write = input carried over), so the selfhost exact table is currently empty and the mechanism is exercised by the source_exact entry below.

big-pickle.note: Self-host addition (P3-A): OpenCode Zen stealth model, officially free ("Big Pickle is a stealth model that's free on OpenCode for a limited time"). Verified 2026-10-22 on the OpenCode Console pricing table, where Big Pickle lists Free input / Free output / Free cached-read: https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/models; pi.dev's provider config mirrors cost {input:0, output:0, cacheRead:0, cacheWrite:0}. Source-scoped to opencode rows so the zero rate cannot silently follow the id to another provider; negative cache_write mirrors the official "-" column. Remove or re-point when the free preview window ends — the model collects feedback while free, so paid listing may follow.
